entries.words: end this green and show amber
entries.reason: The fixed plan ends a green at its minimum. Switching then follows its amber and all-red clearance before the other street can get green; this is the idle action and the fallback when no valid answer arrives.

entries.words: keep this green one more second
entries.reason: A model may extend the active street's green one second when a vehicle is near, after the plan's minimum walk and pedestrian clearance. The step checks the request again and refuses an extension at the declared maximum.
